description.value: You raise a shimmering, immobile wall of Force energy up to 10 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick, anywhere within range on a surface you can see. The barrier has AC 5 and 30 hit points, blocks movement and line of sight through it, and vanishes when it is destroyed or when the duration ends.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 2
